summary: The marketing team is executing a China-first pivot, prioritising Asia Star and the new Intelligent China program for SEO/AI-search visibility while finalising the Knowledge website redesign and resolving a persistent Outlook lockout.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting the team; stale saved passwords across multiple devices must be cleared and accounts re-added, with JSB confirming the backend unlock. In parallel, the Knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has chosen to keep the current design with menu improvements and BCI/BSI banners, and Joseph, Julie, and Joker need to hold a 30-minute feedback session to finalise changes. The strategic focus from the 30 June sync remains Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities, with Joseph drafting the target areas/prompts document and the team analysing Asia Star participant profiles and CRM leads. US partner programs (Berkeley, Stanford, Columbia) are on hold for Q1, though Berkeley is third priority if capacity allows. Upcoming actions include auditing Google Ads conversion tracking and prioritising Asia Star and Intelligent China in the SEO plan.
